$doc: Vyomi capability registry — AWS Cost Explorer. See s3.json for the contract.

cost-explorer.cost-and-usage.title: Cost and usage (GetCostAndUsage, GetCostForecast, GetDimensionValues) over the real EC2/EBS/RDS inventory
limitations: Figures are what AWS would have charged: on-demand list prices x the real uptime of the simulator's EC2 instances, EBS volumes and RDS instances. Other services are not metered; stopped instances accrue nothing from when they are observed stopped; HOURLY granularity, tag / cost-category grouping and ML forecasting are not modeled (the forecast extrapolates the current run rate). There are no invoices and no payment methods.

cost-explorer.saved-by-vyomi.title: Saved by Vyomi dashboard (AWS-equivalent cost vs the $0 the simulator bills)
limitations: A Vyomi-only view (the VyomiGetSavings action has no AWS equivalent). It reports estimated list-price savings, not an invoice, and covers only the metered services listed under cost-explorer.cost-and-usage.
